h1: Dener NC surface grinder — TGH-B 450, 17.7 × 35.4″ table
intro: A surface grinder finishes flat, parallel and square faces to tenths: the part sits on a magnetic chuck on a table that runs back and forth under a grinding wheel, the wheel steps across at each stroke and comes down a few tenths at a time until the face is true. NovoTech sells the Dener TGH-B 450 in Canada, built in Kayseri, Turkey: a 17.7 × 35.4″ (450 × 900 mm) table on scraped, Turcite-B coated V and flat guideways, driven hydraulically at 16 – 82 ft/min, a Ø13.8″ (350 mm) wheel on a direct-drive spindle with 21.7″ (550 mm) under the wheel centre, and AC servo motors on ballscrews for the cross and vertical axes under a Mitsubishi NC with a 10″ touchscreen — the operator sets the stock to remove, and the machine down-feeds in 0.00004″ (0.001 mm) steps and cross-feeds 0.002 – 0.79″ per stroke by itself. Installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

groups.title: TGH NC surface grinder
groups.lead: A 450 × 900 mm precision surface grinder with NC cross and down feed and a hydraulic table.

faq.q: What does the NC do on a surface grinder?
faq.a: On a manual grinder the operator turns the handwheels for every pass. On the TGH-B 450 the cross and vertical axes are AC servo axes under the Mitsubishi NC: the operator enters the stock to remove, the down feed per pass and the cross feed, and the machine grinds the face — roughing, finishing and spark-out passes — while the hydraulic table runs back and forth. The handwheel stays for touching off and setup.

faq.q: How large a part can it grind?
faq.a: Faces up to 35.4 × 17.7″ (900 × 450 mm) on the 15.7 × 31.5″ (400 × 800 mm) electromagnetic chuck, parts up to 882 lb (400 kg), and up to 21.7″ (550 mm) from the table to the wheel centre — about 14.8″ of part height under a new Ø13.8″ wheel.

A magnetic sine plate and sine bar for angled faces, a precision toolmaker's vise for non-magnetic parts, a magnetic separator with the paper filter for long coolant life, a wheel-head diamond dresser and a profile dressing attachment for formed wheels, and a demagnetizer for finished parts. A second wheel flange makes wheel changes quick.

faq.q: Do you deliver, install and train in Canada?
faq.a: Yes. Machines ship from Kayseri to Mississauga, ON, Canada; NovoTech unloads, levels and commissions the machine, checks the geometry, trains your operators and programmers on the control and helps with the first parts. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and service from Mississauga. Ask for the foundation drawing and the power and air requirements before the machine ships.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
